{{Quote|The Ryndellia system&hellip; near Naboo. Isn't that where our medical base is?|Anakin Skywalker|audio=RyndelliaSystemNearNaboo-SoM.flac|<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />}}
The '''Ryndellia system''',<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> also known as the '''Kaliida system''',<ref name="FF24">{{FactFile2014|24|22 BBY 87-88|The ''Malevolence'' Campaign}}</ref> was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> located within the [[Ryndellian sector/Legends|Ryndellian sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> which contained [[Ryndellia/Legends|Ryndellia]] and the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]].<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] [[Battle of the Ryndellia system/Legends|attacked]] a medical convoy of [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigates]] here. The ''Malevolence'' later staged an [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|attack]] on the nearby Kaliida Shoals Medical Center, which was foiled by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]].<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ryndellia system first appeared in "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']],"<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> the third episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[October 10]], [[2008]].<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence air date">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref> Although the episode placed the Kaliida Shoals Medical Center in the Ryndellia system, the maps and star system appendixes of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and its [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] incorrectly placed Ryndellia and Kaliida Shoals in two different systems.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="EAOC" />
